name: Pin
fantasy: The warden of high ground. Climbs, reads the field, pins people to walls.
silhouette: the long weapon over the shoulder

card.loop: Ranged marksman: time each bow draw, root foes with snares, then cash a full Focus in as a Deadeye.
card.role: Ranged marksman: time each bow draw, root foes with snares, then cash a full Focus in as a Deadeye.
card.lmb: Hold to draw: Empowered lands at the cursor, Supercharged flies past it; let go right on the flash for a faster next draw.
card.rmb: Tap a rooting snare; hold for a Heavy Shot that knocks back and pins foes to walls.
card.e: Rain arrows on a curved wall at the cursor distance: damage, slow and a burn that blocks healing.
card.dash: Spirit Walk: a dodge roll, then 2.8s walking through rocks, trees and barriers.
card.passive: Focus fills while you stand still or land snares; at full your next shot is a Deadeye. Hurt foes show through cover.
card.x: Starpiercer (level 6): your next 3 shots need no draw and fly as piercing beams; the third can finish a foe.

weapons.longbow: Hold to draw: Empowered lands at the cursor, Supercharged flies past it; let go right on the flash for a faster next draw.

passive.name: Focus
passive.desc: Builds while you stand still (full in 1.4s), sneak (2.8s), 50% faster on high ground; a snare or Heavy Shot that hits adds 40 (a wall pin fills it). Drains while running and drops 40 when hit. At 100 your next shot is Supercharged or aimed at once, with +20% range, and if it hits a rooted or stunned foe it is a Deadeye: +18 damage, a crit. Hawk Sense: rivals under half health are seen through cover within 22m. A knock heals 18.

dash.name: Spirit Walk
dash.desc: A quick dodge roll in the direction you move (or aim), then 2.8s as a spirit: rocks, trees, pillars and ability barriers don't stop you (cliffs and ledges still do); you move 10% faster, 35% inside something. Walking into something leaves a spirit orb there for 4s: anyone who touches it walks as a spirit too. Taking damage ends it. If it ends while you're inside something you lose 30 Focus and are put back where you went in.

variants.tap: A snare arrow 11m: 8 damage and root 0.6 on a foe; on the ground it plants a Tripwire (root 1.2, reveal 3s).
variants.hold: Heavy Shot: charge 0.5s -> full at 1.1s (rising creak, a ring, a ping at full): 16 -> 30 damage, push 6 -> 12, pierces 2; driven into a wall within 3m it hits again (up to 12) and stuns 1.2 (PINNED).
variants.air: Plunge: shoot straight down, push 8 around you, lift yourself 3m, cool the glider.
variants.during_e: With your Hail Wall falling the tap snare roots 1.0.

e.name: Hail Wall
e.desc: Lob a volley: 0.35s later arrows rain for 4.4s on a curved wall 120 degrees wide round you, at the cursor distance (2-9m). Foes inside take 5 every 0.5s, are slowed 35% and burn blue (healing barely takes). A Heavy Shot that knocks a burning foe Cremates them: +10 and a longer burn.

x.name: Starpiercer
x.desc: Tap: your next 3 bow shots within 6s need no draw. Each press nocks for 0.3s and looses a beam to 18m that pierces every foe, knocks back and strips 10 armor; the third hits harder and finishes a hunter it leaves under 12% health.

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 9s -> 7.2s, damage +30%; max 3 live Tripwires.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 9s -> 7.2s, damage +30%; the Hail Wall is 30% wider.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 6s -> 4.2s; Spirit Walk lasts 0.6s longer.

tells.full: a bright glint and a thin aim line; crosshairs over every rooted foe
tells.dash_spent: a green spirit shell over her while it lasts; dash pip dark
